items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: A lot of those young drummers don't like a Max Roach or Elvin Jones or like that you know.

ctx.x: Yeah, but this was another boy. God, I'm just bad on names.
No, boy out of Chicago. Well anyway he didn't show on the recording date, so Diz and Burt called me and that's how I happened to do it.
